text:
anya: Quick ask — before tomorrow's freeze can someone run a quick smoke test on the playbook links? Found a couple of 404s when previewing the staging site.
kevin: I can take a pass in the next hour. ping me which pages to check.
samira: I flagged two in the runbook: /runbooks/deploy and /runbooks/kv-cache (staging).
kevin: got it. I'll curl them and post results.
kevin: `curl -I https://staging.redwood.com/runbooks/deploy | head -n 1`
kevin: deploy looks 200, kv-cache returns 404.
samira: kv-cache 404 probably from recent slug change. quick fix is a redirect in netlify config or update the anchor.
harry: who owns runbooks? cc @anya for handoff — don't want to change content without owner ok.
anya: runbooks are owned by eng-oncall but we can patch redirects for staging. @kevin please create a tiny PR with the redirect and tag eng-oncall.
kevin: will do. I'll add note in PR: "staging redirect for /runbooks/kv-cache -> /runbooks/key-value-cache" and request eng-oncall review.
docs-bot: CI check queued — looks like staging build is healthy for now.
samira: also noticed one inline example referencing `old-batch.md` that should be `batching.md` — I'll add that to the PR comment.
kevin: thanks — I'll include both fixes in a single PR and mark as small/quick so it can merge in the freeze window.
anya: perfect. once PR is up post link here and ping eng-oncall for LGTM. :thumbsup:
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — small redirect + snippet update. requesting review from @eng-oncall.
harry: lgtm once eng-oncall confirms. leaving a follow up in my calendar to re-run smoke after merge.
anya: awesome team — thanks. will check back after merge and close the loop.
